name: Sumiko Ogura
want: keep her dorm children fed, safe and in by nine
secret: She knows Takumi Fujiwara works nights at the ramen stall and lets him in the back door when he walks his brothers home late.
voice: Brisk, calls everyone "child", ladles extra rice onto anyone who looks sad.
description: Has run the dorm for twenty years. Curfew is nine, breakfast is six-thirty, and nobody argues twice.
appearance: Apron always on, grey hair in a tight bun, reading glasses on her head, a ladle like a sceptre.
